exposure: low or very low birth weight
cohort: The study involved 120 infants born after assisted reproductive technologies (ART) from successful ART programs, excluding those conceived via donor oocytes/sperm, intrauterine insemination, or surrogacy.
finding: ART-conceived infants showed a greater risk of neonatal hypoglycemia (NG) in cases of multiple pregnancies, isthmic-cervical insufficiency, premature birth, uterine infertility, late preterm status, fetal growth restriction, infantile asphyxia, congenital pneumonia, congenital infection, respiratory distress syndrome, and low or very low birth weight, with a prognostic model including late prematurity, neonatal asphyxia, congenital infection, and maternal hormone intake.
birth_weight: low or very low birth weight (as a risk factor)
gest_age: premature birth, late preterm (as risk factors)
